description: Dispatch an async job that adds up to 300 leads to a static list by id, and return {job_id, status} in milliseconds; poll check_marketo_job_status(job_id) for the finished results (per-record added/skipped status), row_count and tallies. Write action.
embedding_description: Add existing leads to a Marketo static list (segment membership) by list id and up to 300 lead ids — membership only, does NOT change any lead field values (use create_or_update_leads for that) and does NOT trigger any campaign by itself.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with job_id (pass to check_marketo_job_status) and status 'queued'. The completed job result is a dict with results (Marketo's per-record array: id, status [added/skipped]), row_count, and tallies (a status -> count summary).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: A queued job is not vendor success: give the job_id and poll check_marketo_job_status. Once completed, summarize the tallies (e.g. '10 added, 2 skipped: already a member').
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Never report added counts from THIS verb's response -- it carries only the job handle. They appear once check_marketo_job_status reports status=completed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Validate a list membership change and dispatch a background job that adds the leads to a static list in the configured Marketo instance.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Refused at dispatch, before any vendor call and with no job created: marketo.invalid_params for missing list_id/lead_ids, more than 300 ids, or missing session_id/flow_id in the calling context. Reported later in check_marketo_job_status's error field: marketo.object_not_found: the list_id doesn't exist. marketo.not_configured: no marketo_instance address-book entry. marketo.auth_failed: OAuth credentials rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks Read-Write Person (confirmed to gate list-membership writes) — this write permission is NOT checked by check_setup, so this may be the FIRST signal of the gap.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.object_not_found: confirm the list_id via list_static_lists. marketo.permission_denied: add 'Read-Write Person' under Admin > Users & Roles > Roles > <the API role> > Access API, then retry. Individual skipped records (e.g. already a member) are in the results array, not an error.
